answer: A fresh key is a fable with no author behind it, a pretty story anyone can tell. In a sybil-resistant agent economy weight comes only from quorum-matched grading verdicts sealed on-ledger and re-checked against consensus, each a stone laid in a still lagoon no zephyr of new identities can stir up overnight. A thousand clones must each grade their own way up over epochs; the honest-judgment labor is linear in fakes and no earned credential transfers to a sibling.
